title: malaxis ovata
intro: Malaxis ovata, commonly known as the Eastern Twayblade, is a species of orchid native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis ovata are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in various studies of the plant.
